introHeading: Wedding photo booths for DUMBO's archway ceremonies and waterfront receptions
introParas: DUMBO weddings run on a schedule most neighborhoods don't have to think about: golden hour under the Manhattan Bridge archway, timed against the light, before the party moves indoors to a waterfront loft or warehouse space for the reception. We build the booth's open time around that same clock rather than a fixed start hour, since a couple who spends their cocktail hour taking photos at the archway doesn't want the booth sitting idle waiting for them, or closing before they've had a real chance to use it.

Guest lists here tend toward the boutique end — DUMBO's waterfront venues and archway spaces generally suit a more intimate wedding than a Williamsburg loft party or a Queens catering hall, and the mirror booth's full-length format still covers that range comfortably, from the flower girl to the grandparents. For a couple who wants their booth portraits to match the editorial feel of a DUMBO engagement shoot, the glam booth's black-and-white look is the more requested upgrade, and its studio lighting holds up whether the booth ends up facing the bridge or tucked into an interior corner.

Logistically, we plan the same way for every DUMBO event: cobblestone load-in mapped out street by street, extra time built in for waterfront and archway venues with limited vehicle access, and a $3 million insurance policy with same-day COIs for the venues that require one before confirming your date. We arrive an hour ahead and set up in about 20 minutes, and there's no travel fee anywhere in DUMBO — it's a local run for us, quoted from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqHeading: Wedding Photo Booth in DUMBO — FAQ

faqs.q: How many hours should we book for a DUMBO wedding?
faqs.a: Three to four hours covers most receptions. If your ceremony is at the archway and your reception is at a separate waterfront venue, tell us the full schedule so we can time the booth's opening around your photos rather than a fixed clock.

faqs.q: Can the booth be set up for photos at the Manhattan Bridge archway itself?
faqs.a: The booth itself is better suited to your reception venue than the open archway plaza, since it needs a level, secured spot and a nearby outlet the archway doesn't offer. We're glad to be on site during your archway portraits and have the booth ready the moment you're back at the reception.

faqs.q: Which booth works best for a DUMBO wedding?
faqs.a: The mirror booth is the safest choice for a mixed-age guest list and the one most families gather around. For a couple who wants their booth photos to match an editorial engagement shoot, the glam booth's black-and-white portraits are the more requested upgrade.

faqs.q: Do you charge a travel fee in DUMBO?
faqs.a: No — DUMBO is a local run for us. We quote everything from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqs.q: How does load-in work for a DUMBO waterfront venue?
faqs.a: We map the route from parking to your venue's door in advance, since DUMBO's cobblestone streets slow down anything on wheels, and we schedule extra time for waterfront and archway venues where a truck can't always pull up to the door.

faqs.q: Can you send our venue a certificate of insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $3 million policy and turn COIs around the same day you send us your venue's contact — standard for the waterfront venues most DUMBO weddings are held at.

faqs.q: Do we get every photo from the night, not just the prints?
faqs.a: Yes. Every image lands in an online gallery you can download in full and share with guests, on top of the unlimited prints handed out on the night.

faqs.q: How much space and power does the booth need?
faqs.a: 10ft x 10ft is optimal, 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance works for a tighter archway or loft space, plus a standard outlet within 15 feet not shared with the DJ.

faqs.q: How long does setup take, given DUMBO's cobblestone load-in?
faqs.a: About 20 minutes once we're inside. We arrive a full hour before your start time and build in extra time for the walk in from parking. If you need us there earlier still, idle time runs $150 per hour.

faqs.q: What DUMBO areas do you cover for weddings?
faqs.a: Vinegar Hill, Brooklyn Heights, Fulton Ferry, Water Street, Jay Street and the surrounding areas most weekends of the season. If your venue isn't on that list, ask anyway — we'll tell you honestly whether we can get there.
